name: EPIC 242189351
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 10.1 solar radii and 1.23 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,540 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.23 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,472 K at its surface.
